title: Initial Exploration of the Ruins
next_chapter_hook: A eerie laughter echoed from the depths of the ruins, and a familiar figure appeared before Chen Ji. That laughter carried a chilling sense of familiarity, as if coming from the past he least wanted to face.

text.content: The blood contract inscription on the ancient stone tablet glowed with a dim light—those who entered needed blood as the guide and sincerity as the key. Chen Ji gazed at those words, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes, and already had a plan in mind. He nonchalantly rolled up his left sleeve, revealing a faint golden blood pulse marking on his inner wrist—a unique identifier of the direct Chen bloodline, never shown to outsiders for a thousand years. 'Since they require blood as the guide...' he murmured softly, a slight smile curving his lips. 'Let me show you what true bloodline really means.' His sharp fingernail cut across the skin, and several drops of essence blood, glowing with a faint golden light, dripped onto the stone tablet. In an instant, the entire tablet shuddered violently, the dim light transforming into a dazzling golden radiance that surged outward like a tide.

A crack slowly opened in the center of the stone tablet, and an immense, ancient aura rushed toward them. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, seeing within the depths of the crack an enormous underground palace. The dome was inlaid with unknown starlight stones, emanating a soft silvery glow. The palace was densely covered with prohibitions, layer upon layer of formations flickering in various colors, dividing the entire palace into countless separate spaces. 'What magnificent craftsmanship.' Chen Ji quietly exclaimed, but also spotted the catch—though these prohibitions were powerful, after ten thousand years of erosion, their might had fallen to less than a tenth of their prime. 'If it were anyone else, entering would mean certain death. Unfortunately...' He stepped into the crack. 'I possess what they lack.'

Su Qingyao's voice came from behind. Chen Ji's steps paused slightly, but he didn't look back, only saying coolly, 'Senior Sister Su, this is not the Inner Sect training grounds.' Su Qingyao caught up, her plain white garments stained with dust, clearly having traveled at speed. Her gaze swept over the layered prohibitions, her brow furrowing: 'These formations... if I'm not mistaken, they are the work of the ancient Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. Legend has it that the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion excelled at using blood as the key and intent as the lock—ordinary people simply cannot enter.' She glanced at Chen Ji, a hint of inquiry flashing in her eyes: 'Who exactly are you? Why can you trigger the mechanisms here?'

dialogue.content: I'm just a Servant Disciple who happens to have the surname Chen.

text.content: Su Qingyao stared at him for a long time, but from his calm face she could find no flaw. She snorted coldly: 'Fine, keep your secrets. But this place is extremely dangerous, and going in alone is seeking death.' She raised her hand and凝聚出一道spiritual energy护罩, 'I'm sticking with you.' A slight twitch appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth—this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was indeed stubborn. However, having someone to share the risk wasn't entirely bad. Besides, Su Qingyao's Combat Power was considerable; if they truly ran into trouble, she'd be a useful blade. He didn't refuse, only saying coolly: 'As you wish. But let me be clear—if you die here, it's none of my concern.'

The two stepped into the palace, and the silvery starlight stretched their figures long. Chen Ji walked forward slowly, and with each step, a prohibition's light would flicker. However, strangely, those prohibitions seemed to have eyes, parting before him to create a passage. 'As expected.' Chen Ji thought secretly. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's prohibitions used blood as the key, and his Chen bloodline was precisely the descendant of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's founder. These prohibitions would not only not harm him, they would open their doors to him. Su Qingyao beside him watched in utter astonishment—the prohibitions enough to tear apart Foundation Building cultivators were docile before Chen Ji like house cats!

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao witnessed the spectacle of bloodline breaking formations, becoming even more curious about Chen Ji's identity. At this moment, Chen Ji faced a choice: to continue displaying this astonishing ability completely, or to hold something back?

choices.description: The truth of bloodline-breaking formations is too shocking; continuing to display it may attract more trouble. Let Su Qingyao stay here and explore the ruins' core alone.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Su Qingyao's Combat Power support
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the mystery of identity, avoid revealing more trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Face unknown dangers alone with no backup

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, turning to look at Su Qingyao, his expression cold: 'Senior Sister Su, the prohibitions ahead are complex. Though your Combat Power is strong, you're unfamiliar with the formations here. Stay here and wait for me, so there's someone to provide backup.' Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly: 'You want to send me away again?' Chen Ji shook his head: 'Not sending you away. Just telling the truth.' He raised his hand, pointing to the dense prohibitions ahead: 'These formations are bloodline-activated. If you enter, it's a death sentence. If I bring you in, wouldn't that be harming you?' The words were frank, leaving Su Qingyao with no room for rebuttal. She could indeed see how terrifying those prohibitions were.

choices.description: Since Su Qingyao has already witnessed the ability to break formations with bloodline, might as well顺势 display more strength, drawing her completely into his scheme.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more trump cards, arousing deeper suspicion from Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and Combat Power support
choices.risk_hint: Need more lies later to cover up

text.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly, suddenly grabbing Su Qingyao's wrist and pulling her forward. Su Qingyao was about to struggle when she saw the surrounding prohibitions part like Moses parting the sea, creating a passage. 'This...' Her eyes widened. Without looking back, Chen Ji said: 'Hold on tight. Some things, I'll explain later.' His tone brooked no argument; Su Qingyao inexplicably didn't pull away. The two passed through the gaps in the prohibitions, Su Qingyao's heart racing—not from danger, but because for the first time she felt such a reassuring strength emanating from this 'waste.'

Passing through the layered prohibitions, Chen Ji and Su Qingyao arrived at the depths of the palace. The scene before them made both simultaneously hold their breath—a massive stone coffin stood quietly in the center, its lid covered with complex talismans. Around the coffin, dozens of white bones knelt in worship posture, as if kowtowing to whoever lay within. 'This is...' Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly, 'the fallen place of an ancient great one?' Chen Ji said nothing. His gaze fell on the ground before the coffin—where a massive map was carved, written in an extinct ancient script. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—that was the treasure map of the complete Tianji Record!

Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his surging excitement, walking slowly toward that map. Faint golden bloodline energy flowed from his fingertips, and the ancient script on the map slowly illuminated. A grand scroll unfolded before the two of them—mountains, rivers, cities, forbidden lands... A complete continental survey map. And at the map's center, a red dot marked a towering peak that pierced the clouds, beside which four ancient characters were written: 'Apex of Heavenly Dao.' 'Apex of Heavenly Dao...' Su Qingyao murmured, 'that's the legendary place of ascension! It's said ancient greats all crossed the Heavenly Tribulation at the Apex of Heavenly Dao to step into the immortal realm!' Her expression changed slightly, 'This map... points to the Apex of Heavenly Dao?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, what exactly are you looking for?

text.content: "Chen Ji did not answer. His attention was entirely focused on another detail of the map—beside the red dot, there was a line of small text: 'When Heavenly Secrets return to their place, Heavenly Fate shall be reshaped.' His heart lurched violently. Heavenly Secrets returning... the complete Tianji Record. Heavenly Fate reshaped... what did this mean? Could the complete Tianji Record be not merely a tool for foresight, but a divine artifact capable of rewriting destiny itself? 'Do you see this?' Su Qingyao suddenly pointed to the edge of the map, 'What's marked here... is the Imperial Dynasty's Dragon Vein!'"

"Chen Ji followed her finger and indeed saw a winding blue line in the northwest corner of the map, marked with four ancient characters: 'Dragon Vein Source.' His brow furrowed slightly—the Imperial Dynasty's Dragon Vein was the foundation supporting the运气 of the entire Great Chen Empire. For countless years, countless forces had sought to covet the Dragon Vein, yet all returned empty-handed. If the treasure location of the complete Tianji Record was connected to the Dragon Vein... the depths of this matter were far greater than he had imagined. 'Interesting.' Chen Ji murmured, 'It seems someone has set up quite a grand scheme.'"

"Just then, a cacophony of voices came from outside the palace. Chen Ji's brow furrowed, his figure flashing as he silently approached the hall entrance. Through the cracks, he witnessed a harrowing scene—dozens of disciples from various sects were struggling forward within the prohibitions. Those formations that had been so docile toward him were now like maddened beasts, tearing the intruders to shreds. Screams echoed continuously, and blood dyed the prohibition's radiance crimson. 'These prohibitions...' Su Qingyao caught up, her face pale, 'They show no mercy to outsiders!'"

dialogue.content: "The methods of the Ancient Heavenly Secrets Pavilion were indeed extraordinary."

text.content: "A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, yet he felt no sympathy. These people had invaded an ancient ruin driven by greed, and deserved death. More importantly, they had bought him precious time. The complete Tianji Record lay hidden at the Apex of Heavenly Way. And now, he was the only one who knew this secret. 'Senior Sister Su.' he suddenly spoke, 'What do you intend to do with this map?' Su Qingyao froze for a moment, then understood the deeper meaning in his words—the value of this map was enough to trigger a bloodbath across the cultivation world. She looked at Chen Ji, her gaze complicated: 'Do you want to silence me?'"

choice.prompt: "The map's secret was too shocking. Su Qingyao had already seen the treasure location. Chen Ji needed to decide how to handle this witness—whether to silence her, recruit her, or temporarily set it aside."

choices.description: "Su Qingyao had already seen everything. Rather than silencing her and inviting greater trouble, it was better to be frank, drawing her into his own chess game."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain a powerful ally, share the map information burden"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao might report to the sect"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji turned around, meeting Su Qingyao's gaze directly, speaking with rare seriousness: 'Silence you? Chen Ji is not that despicable.' He pointed to his own eyes, 'I am indeed searching for something related to the Tianji Record. But it is not a life-or-death struggle, rather... something I must do.' He paused, 'You can choose to leave as if you saw nothing, or you can choose to... help me with something.' Su Qingyao was silent for a long while, then suddenly laughed lightly: 'Is this a recruitment?'"

choices.description: "Let Su Qingyao understand the danger level of this matter, warning her strongly that she must not leak information, or face the consequences."
choices.visible_reward: "Temporarily suppress Su Qingyao, protect the secret"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao may become more suspicious and investigate"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned ice-cold, an invisible pressure erupting from him, pressing directly toward Su Qingyao. 'Senior Sister Su, I advise you one thing.' His voice was low and dangerous, 'For some matters, the more you know, the faster you die.' Su Qingyao's face paled slightly, yet she did not retreat: 'Are you threatening me?' Chen Ji shook his head: 'Not a threat. Advice.' He stepped forward, close enough to Su Qingyao that they were nearly touching, 'The things on this map are enough to drive the entire cultivation world mad. If you leak this, not just you, but the entire Tianqing Sect will bring disaster upon itself.'"

text.content: "Just as the atmosphere reached the breaking point, a crisp laugh echoed from deep within the palace. 'Hehehe... What interesting humans.' That laughter was ethereal yet eerie, reverberating through the spacious palace, sending chills down one's spine. Chen Ji's pupils constricted as he spun around—that direction led to the deepest passage of the palace. Su Qingyao also suppressed her earlier emotions, spiritual energy surging in her hands: 'What's there?' Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze was fixed死死地盯着那片黑暗. Because he recognized that voice—one he was infinitely familiar with, yet should never appear here."

"A figure emerged slowly from the darkness. Silvery-white hair, blood-red pupils, a smile on the corner of her lips that was both innocent and eerie. Chen Ji's breath caught abruptly—that face, the face he had yearned for整整十年的脸. 'Nian'er...' His voice was hoarse, squeezed out between his teeth. Indeed, walking out from the darkness was his sister who had been missing for ten years—Chen Nian. But now, she was wrapped in eerie black mist, her aura so deep and terrifying, nothing like the innocent girl from a decade ago."

dialogue.content: "Brother... I've been waiting for you for so long."

text.content: "That smile was brilliant and innocent, yet it nearly froze all the blood in Chen Ji's body. Ten years. He had searched整整十年. From atrash disciple to one who orchestrated the world, everything he had done was to find his sister. Yet now, upon truly seeing Chen Nian, he felt no joy of reunion. Because he saw it—around Chen Nian's neck was wrapped a thin black-gold chain, the other end of which disappeared into the void. That was... the Holy Sect's 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' prohibition! Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping, yet he was completely unaware. Ten years... his sister had been so imprisoned and tormented all this time!"

"From the depths of the ruins came an eerie laugh, and a familiar figure appeared before Chen Ji—that was his sister Chen Nian, missing for ten years, yet no longer the person she once was. Silver hair, red pupils, wrapped in eerie black mist, and around her neck a black-gold chain that imprisoned her soul. Chen Ji's heart churned with surging fury and endless heartache, yet his expression became increasingly calm like still water. Looking at the sister the Holy Sect had imprisoned as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' for ten years, there was only one thought in his mind: This time, regardless of what price he had to pay, he would rescue her from this cage."
